Thanks for looping me in. Kevin — quick note on scope so you can triage in your portal: for a demo that covers regulated triage workflows we typically need:

- Signed mutual NDA (standard)
- Completed vendor intake questionnaire (security controls, data residency, retention, encryption, access controls) — the first pass is usually 50–60 fields
- Evidence for a couple control families (network diagrams, encryption-at-rest config, SOC2 cert or recent audit letter if available) — if Orchid doesn’t have SOC2 we can accept compensating controls for the preview.

If you can return the questionnaire responses and the NDA within ~5 business days we can keep the demo window in the week of 6/24.

Options to move faster:
- We can run a short 20m architecture review with Marissa and me (no customer data) to cover high-level security posture while legal finalizes the NDA.
- Or if you send a prioritized subset of the questionnaire (critical controls only) we’ll accept that as a pre-demo artifact and reopen a 30m slot sooner.

I’ll attach our questionnaire template (sent to Jordan) and a short checklist of the minimal artifacts. Happy to jump on a quick call with your security ops.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
